name: week
title: This week across the yards
subtitle: Breaches, holds, money waiting and contracts, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each row cites its rule. Sources in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record, detail, due_on, days_left, source from compliance_findings order by rule, record

sections.title: Goods on hold
sections.sql: select ticket, line_no, site, seller, grade, net_kg, item_no, hold_until, days_left, state_now from held_items where released_on is null order by hold_until

sections.title: Weighed and not paid
sections.sql: select ticket, site, received_on, days_waiting, seller, net_kg, amount_cents from unpaid_tickets order by days_waiting desc

sections.title: Sellers worth a second look
sections.sql: select seller_code, seller, tickets_30d, copper_tickets_30d, copper_kg_30d, reason from seller_watch order by copper_tickets_30d desc

name: yard
title: Stock, contracts and margin
subtitle: What is in the yards, what is sold forward, and what each grade made

sections.title: Open contracts
sections.sql: select code, buyer, grade, tonnes, deliver_by, days_left, shipped_t, remaining_t, in_yard_t from contract_position order by deliver_by

sections.title: Yard stock
sections.sql: select site, grade, grade_name, on_hand_kg, avg_cost_cents_per_tonne as avg_cost_per_tonne_cents, days_since_moved from yard_stock where on_hand_kg > 0 order by site, on_hand_kg desc

sections.title: Margin by grade, last 30 days
sections.sql: select grade, grade_name, bought_kg, avg_buy_cents_per_tonne as avg_buy_per_tonne_cents, sold_kg, avg_sell_cents_per_tonne as avg_sell_per_tonne_cents, margin_cents_per_tonne as margin_per_tonne_cents from grade_margin order by grade

name: prices
title: Price board
subtitle: Today's buy prices at every yard

sections.title: Public prices
sections.sql: select site, grade, grade_name, cents_per_tonne as per_tonne_cents, effective_on, days_old from current_prices where seller_kind = 'public' order by site, family, grade

sections.title: Trade prices
sections.sql: select site, grade, grade_name, cents_per_tonne as per_tonne_cents, effective_on, days_old from current_prices where seller_kind = 'trade' order by site, family, grade
